data.one_liner: Play system ringtones, alarms, notifications and custom audio on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Plays default device alarms, ringtones, notification sounds, local audio files, and Flutter assets. Features looping, perceptual volume scaling, playback state streams, and error handling.
use_when: You need to play alarms, ringtones, or notification sounds in your app.
You are migrating away from the unmaintained flutter_ringtone_player package.
You need to play custom audio files or assets with looping and volume controls on Android and iOS.
avoid_when: You need complex audio streaming, mixing, or advanced audio processing.
You are targeting macOS or web, which are not currently supported.
strengths: Supports looping, volume, and stop controls consistently on both Android and iOS.
Provides playback state streams and typed exceptions.
Drop-in migration path for flutter_ringtone_player users.
weaknesses: macOS and web support are not yet implemented.
Limited to short sound effects, ringtones, alarms, and notifications rather than full-scale media player features.
data.setup_notes: To keep a sound playing while your app is in the background on iOS, add audio to UIBackgroundModes in Info.plist.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a feature-rich media player for complex audio playback, streaming, and advanced controls.

alternatives.name: audioplayers
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a general-purpose audio playback library for multiple simultaneous tracks or simple audio effects.
